### Overview:

* All default homeguard particle effects removed.
* This does not include extraordinary trails such as Samira Soul Fighter, although maybe in the future I will remove them as well.
* This edits a somewhat volatile bin, so keep in mind this will very likely need an update at some point. I will have it made, you just need to redownload it.

Tell me of any extra homeguards for specific skins if you want me to remove them so I can add it to the mod.
